names: the schema is idempotent and its catalog is the canonical 13 departments
enqueue is idempotent: the same key never creates a second job
reservation holds one job at a time and releases the slot on completion
a lease can only be used by its owner and only while it is valid
interrupted work is recovered exactly once and never duplicated
a healthy heartbeat protects a running job from recovery
retries are bounded, back off and end in FAILED without an infinite loop
expired leases that exhausted their attempts fail instead of looping forever
the quota ladder stops work at 50 / 70 / 85 / 95 percent and declares monthly quota unknown
recording a provider call opens the circuit once the quota is exhausted
queue metrics are real counts and separate registered / connected / operative agents
least privilege: workers cannot write tables directly and reader cannot execute queue operations
the schema contains no statement about Arena tables or privileged roles
the package applies on top of a pre-existing hive schema without losing a single row
re-applying is a no-op and never duplicates the census or the catalog
duplicated idempotency keys abort the migration instead of deleting data
the destination gate rejects any target that is not the authorised Hive TEST project
the destination gate rejects a database that looks like UGO Arena
the destination gate rejects a database already marked with another project
agents activate one at a time: the census guard blocks a mass deployment of 118
real PostgreSQL is available for concurrency evidence
20 independent sessions compete for one slot: exactly one lease is granted
raising max_concurrent_jobs to 3 grants exactly 3 distinct leases under contention
fencing token: a worker whose lease expired cannot complete the job
two sessions completing the same job with the same token: exactly one wins
external effects are idempotent by effect_key even when the job runs twice
concurrent recovery by two sessions requeues each expired lease exactly once
ten sessions enqueueing the same idempotency key create a single job
